# [320. 列举单词的全部缩写](https://leetcode-cn.com/problems/generalized-abbreviation) [English Version](https://github.com/yanglr/leetcode-ac/blob/master/assets/0300-0399/0320.Generalized%20Abbreviation/README_EN.md) ## 题目描述

请你写出一个能够举单词全部缩写的函数。

注意：输出的顺序并不重要。

示例：

输入: "word"
输出:
["word", "1ord", "w1rd", "wo1d", "wor1", "2rd", "w2d", "wo2", "1o1d", "1or1", "w1r1", "1o2", "2r1", "3d", "w3", "4"]
